description: This file defines a React component named NoteGroupView for a web application, managing the display of notes and files, the state of selected items, and rendering corresponding subcomponents for multiple or single selections.

classes.name: NoteGroupView
classes.description: A React component that manages the display of grouped notes or files, handles state updates, and renders appropriate subcomponents based on selection and view context.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets initial state variables.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up observers and autoruns to update component state based on application state changes.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up observers when the component is unmounted.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate subcomponents based on current state, including multiple notes, multiple files, or individual note or file views.
